Messages.Author: Gord Culleton
Messages.Body:
What would happen if: A Nosferatu were about to play
Nosferatu Justicar, and was blocked. The acting Meth
then used Mask to have a Malkavian (or any other clan)
take the action instead? I read in the FAQ that Mask
allows vampires to take actions they normally couldn't,
a la Muddles, but does it stretch this far?

Behind the Beauty, Jere
Cracks Appear... Culleton

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
bg...@FreeNet.Carleton.CA (Gord Culleton) writes:

>What would happen if: A Nosferatu were about to play
>Nosferatu Justicar, and was blocked. The acting Meth
>then used Mask to have a Malkavian (or any other clan)
>take the action instead? I read in the FAQ that Mask
>allows vampires to take actions they normally couldn't,
>a la Muddles, but does it stretch this far?

Clan Justicar votes to not automatically name the acting vampire
to be the Justicar, so the Malk in your example could legally
take the action regardless of playing the Mask1K or not.

The Clan Justicar votes say "Choose a ready <clan member>. Successful
vote means that vampire is the <Clan> Justicar." So your Mask'ing
Malkavian would still have to choose a ready Nosferatu.
